sourcedFrom: 590RM™ 12 GA. PUMP ACTION SHOTGUN WITH DETACHABLE MAGAZINE AND ROTARY SAFETY — Mossberg owner's manual — Part No. 106252, Manual Rev B, typeset 12/18/2024 (2024)
cleanIntro: The 590RM is the box-magazine 590 with a rotary selector instead of a tang button, and both of those change how you start. The selector has to be read off the receiver text rather than felt for a detent at the tang, and the magazine coming out still leaves a round in the chamber. The strip itself is the familiar one — take-down nut, barrel, two punches — with one step the 590M has not got.

steps.title: Selector to SAFE — read it, do not just feel it
steps.action: Rotate the Safety Selector fully into its detent and check that it is pointing at the SAFE text on the receiver. This is the real difference from a tang-safety 590: you confirm a rotary selector by looking at where it points, not by feeling where it stopped.
steps.aside: Placing the safety in an intermediate position between the SAFE and FIRE position can result in the user thinking the firearm is in a SAFE or FIRE position when it is not.
steps.quote: The Manual Safety is set in the SAFE condition by rotating the Safety Selector fully into its detented position and it points to the “SAFE” text on the Receiver
steps.cite: 590RM™ 12 GA. PUMP ACTION SHOTGUN WITH DETACHABLE MAGAZINE AND ROTARY SAFETY — Mossberg owner's manual — Part No. 106252, Manual Rev B, typeset 12/18/2024 — MANUAL SAFETY, p.10

steps.title: Fingers off the trigger for the whole unload
steps.action: Selector on SAFE, muzzle somewhere harmless, and nothing touches the trigger until the gun is proven empty — not a finger, not a cleaning rod, not a rag.
steps.quote: Move the Safety Selector fully to the SAFE position. During unloading, never allow fingers or any other objects to contact the Trigger.
steps.cite: 590RM™ 12 GA. PUMP ACTION SHOTGUN WITH DETACHABLE MAGAZINE AND ROTARY SAFETY — Mossberg owner's manual — Part No. 106252, Manual Rev B, typeset 12/18/2024 — UNLOADING THE FIREARM, p.14

steps.title: Magazine out — push forward on release AND magazine
steps.action: Grasp the magazine and push forward on both the magazine release and the magazine together. It is a two-handed push-and-rock rather than a button-and-drop, and the magazine does not fall free on its own.
steps.quote: Remove the Magazine by grasping the Magazine and pushing forward on both the Magazine Release and the Magazine.
steps.cite: 590RM™ 12 GA. PUMP ACTION SHOTGUN WITH DETACHABLE MAGAZINE AND ROTARY SAFETY — Mossberg owner's manual — Part No. 106252, Manual Rev B, typeset 12/18/2024 — UNLOADING THE FIREARM, p.14

steps.title: Action release lever UP, forearm fully back
steps.action: Press upwards on the action release lever — forward of the pistol grip on the left — and pull the forearm fully rearward to throw out whatever is in the chamber. Note the direction: this lever is pressed UP, where a tang-safety 590's is depressed.
steps.quote: Press upwards on the Action Release Lever and pull the Forearm fully rearward to extract any shotshell remaining in the chamber.
steps.cite: 590RM™ 12 GA. PUMP ACTION SHOTGUN WITH DETACHABLE MAGAZINE AND ROTARY SAFETY — Mossberg owner's manual — Part No. 106252, Manual Rev B, typeset 12/18/2024 — UNLOADING THE FIREARM, p.14

steps.title: Eyes and fingers in the chamber, receiver and magazine
steps.action: Check all three, by sight and by touch, before a single part comes off. On a detachable-magazine gun there are two places a shell can hide and people check only one.
steps.quote: After unloading, always visually and physically inspect the chamber, Receiver and Magazine to make sure that all of the shotshells have been removed.
steps.cite: 590RM™ 12 GA. PUMP ACTION SHOTGUN WITH DETACHABLE MAGAZINE AND ROTARY SAFETY — Mossberg owner's manual — Part No. 106252, Manual Rev B, typeset 12/18/2024 — UNLOADING THE FIREARM, p.14

steps.title: Glasses on — oil splatter and spring-loaded parts
steps.action: The book names the two reasons by name, and both are real on this gun: solvent flicking off a brush, and small parts under spring load.
steps.quote: Wear eye protection during disassembly and cleaning to protect your eyes from oil splatter or spring loaded components.
steps.cite: 590RM™ 12 GA. PUMP ACTION SHOTGUN WITH DETACHABLE MAGAZINE AND ROTARY SAFETY — Mossberg owner's manual — Part No. 106252, Manual Rev B, typeset 12/18/2024 — DISASSEMBLY, p.16

steps.title: Bolt to the middle of the ejection port
steps.action: Walk the forearm slowly forward from fully rearward until the bolt face sits mid-port. That is where the nut and barrel come off without fighting the action.
steps.quote: Move the Forearm slowly forward from the fully rearward position until the front of the Bolt is in the middle of the ejection port.
steps.cite: 590RM™ 12 GA. PUMP ACTION SHOTGUN WITH DETACHABLE MAGAZINE AND ROTARY SAFETY — Mossberg owner's manual — Part No. 106252, Manual Rev B, typeset 12/18/2024 — DISASSEMBLY, p.16

steps.title: Take-down nut off, counterclockwise
steps.action: Turn the take-down nut counterclockwise and set it aside. ⛔ This is the part that is NOT a magazine cap — on a 590RM the tube under the barrel is a guide tube, and the nut retains the barrel rather than capping a spring.
steps.quote: Remove the Take-down Nut by turning it counterclockwise
steps.cite: 590RM™ 12 GA. PUMP ACTION SHOTGUN WITH DETACHABLE MAGAZINE AND ROTARY SAFETY — Mossberg owner's manual — Part No. 106252, Manual Rev B, typeset 12/18/2024 — DISASSEMBLY, p.16

steps.title: Barrel out with a rocking pull
steps.action: Small back-and-forth rotations while you draw the barrel forward out of the receiver. Straight pulling binds the extension in its seat.
steps.quote: Remove the Barrel with a gentle back-and-forth rotational movement while pulling the Barrel out of the Receiver.
steps.cite: 590RM™ 12 GA. PUMP ACTION SHOTGUN WITH DETACHABLE MAGAZINE AND ROTARY SAFETY — Mossberg owner's manual — Part No. 106252, Manual Rev B, typeset 12/18/2024 — DISASSEMBLY, p.17

steps.title: Magazine catch pins — 3/32" punch
steps.action: Drive out the two magazine catch pins with a punch no larger than 3/32", then rotate the magazine release assembly away from the trigger housing and pull it out. Keep it in one piece as it comes.
steps.aside: Use care to prevent further disassembly of the Magazine Release Assembly.
steps.quote: Using a small punch, no larger than 3/32” diameter, push out the two Magazine Catch Pins.
steps.cite: 590RM™ 12 GA. PUMP ACTION SHOTGUN WITH DETACHABLE MAGAZINE AND ROTARY SAFETY — Mossberg owner's manual — Part No. 106252, Manual Rev B, typeset 12/18/2024 — DISASSEMBLY, p.17

steps.title: ⛔ Selector to FIRE — the step the 590M does not have
steps.action: Before the trigger housing pin comes out, rotate the Safety Selector fully to FIRE. On this gun the selector passes through the housing, and with it on SAFE the housing will not clear the receiver. This is the one place where following a tang-safety 590 procedure on a 590RM leaves you levering at a part that is mechanically locked in place.
steps.quote: Move the Safety Selector fully in the FIRE position.
steps.cite: 590RM™ 12 GA. PUMP ACTION SHOTGUN WITH DETACHABLE MAGAZINE AND ROTARY SAFETY — Mossberg owner's manual — Part No. 106252, Manual Rev B, typeset 12/18/2024 — DISASSEMBLY, p.17

steps.title: Trigger housing pin — 1/8" punch, forward then up
steps.action: Drive the trigger housing pin out with a punch no larger than 1/8", then slide the housing FORWARD first and only then up and out. That forward move is what disengages it; lifting first jams it.
steps.aside: The Trigger Housing Assembly is complex and must not be disassembled.
steps.quote: Remove the Trigger Housing Assembly by first sliding it forward, and then up and out of the Receiver
steps.cite: 590RM™ 12 GA. PUMP ACTION SHOTGUN WITH DETACHABLE MAGAZINE AND ROTARY SAFETY — Mossberg owner's manual — Part No. 106252, Manual Rev B, typeset 12/18/2024 — DISASSEMBLY, p.17

steps.title: Note how bolt, bolt slide and action bars sit
steps.action: Before you separate them, look at how the three relate to each other. The book asks for this explicitly because they go back only one way and the relationship is not obvious once they are apart on a bench.
steps.quote: During disassembly take note of Bolt, Bolt Slide and Action Bars position, as the parts must be in the same relationship during assembly.
steps.cite: 590RM™ 12 GA. PUMP ACTION SHOTGUN WITH DETACHABLE MAGAZINE AND ROTARY SAFETY — Mossberg owner's manual — Part No. 106252, Manual Rev B, typeset 12/18/2024 — DISASSEMBLY, p.17

steps.title: Bolt slide up through the clearance cut, then the bolt
steps.action: Run the forearm back until the bottom of the bolt slide aligns with the clearance cut in the receiver walls, rotate its back end up and lift it out. Then slide the bolt forward, lift its back end and draw it out.
steps.quote: Move the Forearm rearward so that the bottom of the Bolt Slide is aligned with the clearance cut in the sides of the Receiver.
steps.cite: 590RM™ 12 GA. PUMP ACTION SHOTGUN WITH DETACHABLE MAGAZINE AND ROTARY SAFETY — Mossberg owner's manual — Part No. 106252, Manual Rev B, typeset 12/18/2024 — DISASSEMBLY, p.17

deepAbsentReason: The 590RM book publishes a single teardown and stops at the field strip; the trigger housing is declared complex and not to be disassembled, and anything beyond belongs to an authorized Product Service Center or a qualified gunsmith. ⛔ No deeper path is invented for it.

cleaning.name: STRIP FIRST — the book's own order
tasks: Re-prove it empty at the bench: chamber, receiver, magazine
Selector fully SAFE while you work
Glasses on for solvent splatter and sprung parts
cleaning.quote: To clean and lubricate your firearm, first disassemble it (refer to the Disassembly section of this owner’s manual).
cleaning.src: 590RM™ 12 GA. PUMP ACTION SHOTGUN WITH DETACHABLE MAGAZINE AND ROTARY SAFETY — Mossberg owner's manual, CLEANING AND LUBRICATION, p.19

cleaning.name: ⛔ AMMUNITION OUT OF THE ROOM
tasks: No shells anywhere on the cleaning bench
Solvent on a primer or powder can kill a round without you knowing
A dead round left in a barrel is how the next one bursts it
cleaning.quote: Always make sure that no ammunition is located in the area where you clean your firearm.
cleaning.src: 590RM™ 12 GA. PUMP ACTION SHOTGUN WITH DETACHABLE MAGAZINE AND ROTARY SAFETY — Mossberg owner's manual, CLEANING AND LUBRICATION, p.19

cleaning.name: RE-CHECK EMPTY BEFORE THE BRUSH GOES IN
tasks: Chamber, receiver and magazine again, by eye and by finger
Eye protection stays on through assembly, not just cleaning
cleaning.quote: Wear eye protection during cleaning and assembly to protect your eyes from oil splatter and spring loaded components.
cleaning.src: 590RM™ 12 GA. PUMP ACTION SHOTGUN WITH DETACHABLE MAGAZINE AND ROTARY SAFETY — Mossberg owner's manual, CLEANING AND LUBRICATION, p.19

reassembly: Selector still where the strip left it; muzzle safe; bench clear of ammunition.
Bolt, bolt slide and action bars back in the relationship you noted before separating them.
Bolt slide down through the clearance cut, back end last.
Trigger housing in from above and then slid rearward into engagement — the reverse of forward-then-up.
Trigger housing pin flush with the receiver.
Magazine release assembly in, rotated toward the trigger housing, its two pins flush.
Barrel into the receiver with the same rocking motion that took it out.
Take-down nut on clockwise, finger tight.
Selector back to SAFE, and function test before it goes away.
fncheck: Selector to SAFE and confirm it points at the SAFE text. Open the action and check the chamber, receiver and magazine well by eye and finger. Cycle the action several times for free travel. Close it, selector on SAFE, pull the trigger — the hammer must NOT fall. Finger off, rotate to FIRE — it must not fall by itself. Pull the trigger and it should. Open the action and return the selector to SAFE. ⛔ Check the selector is fully in a detent and not resting between positions before the gun is stored.
